# LeadMASTER

> LeadMASTER is an email workspace in development, intended for transactional email and campaigns.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Product direction and current status.
- [Sign in](/login.html): Admin sign-in interface; the authentication service is not yet implemented.

## Implementation status

The repository includes a responsive landing page and sign-in interface, a Turnstile verification helper, an AWS SES SMTP helper, and a Cloudflare Queue dispatch prototype. The email API, authentication service, campaign platform, AI workflows, and MCP integrations are not yet implemented. No public delivery or availability claim is made.
